competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 30% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 to 3 times. Each attack has a 50% chance to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Each attack disturbs the enemy's HP recovery for 1 turn. In addition, when attacked by an enemy, decreases damage taken by 5% per harmful effect on the enemy target. When attacking an enemy (boss excluded), deals additional damage by 4% of the target's MAX HP per harmful effect on the enemy target (up to 12%). [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's HP cannot be recovered.
